race.comment: WINGEANDWIN (11) gets the nod after finishing fourth at Armidale, but it wasn't without interference soon after the jump and again in the straight. Her previous Ipswich effort also had a held-up note, so she has had legitimate excuses while still rating well on recent form. TRADE BARBS (12) was interfered with on the home turn at the Sunshine Coast and is third-up and strikes a more suitable contest. Can improve sharply. OLE ALI (16) finds the maiden win elusive but should find this a bit easier and gets weight relief on the quick back-up. Gets his chance to play a role. O'EXPLOSIVE (13) is yet to fire but has earlier form that measures up. Keeping safe for a minor spot.
